title: Welcome to HaruCMS
excerpt: Get started with HaruCMS and discover the power of flat-file content management. No database required, just simple JSON files and elegant simplicity.
content:
Welcome to HaruCMS, a modern content management system that breaks free from the complexity of traditional database-driven solutions. If you're tired of dealing with database configurations, migrations, and the overhead they bring, HaruCMS offers a refreshing alternative.

What Makes HaruCMS Different?

HaruCMS is built on the principle of simplicity. Instead of storing content in a database, everything is managed through simple JSON files. This means your content is:

  • Version-controlled: Every change is tracked in your version control system
  • Portable: Move your entire site by copying a folder
  • Fast: No database queries, just file reads
  • Secure: No SQL injection vulnerabilities
  • Flexible: Edit content directly in your code editor if needed

Getting Started

Setting up HaruCMS takes just minutes. There's no database to configure, no complex installation process. Simply download the files, point your web server at the directory, and you're ready to go.

The admin interface is intuitive and beautiful, making content management a pleasure rather than a chore. Whether you're creating blog posts, managing pages, or organizing complex content structures, HaruCMS provides the tools you need without the bloat.

Who Is HaruCMS For?

HaruCMS is perfect for developers and content creators who want a simple, fast, and maintainable CMS. It's ideal for:

  • Personal blogs and portfolios
  • Small to medium business websites
  • Documentation sites
  • Any project where simplicity matters

If you're ready to experience content management without the database headaches, HaruCMS is here to help. Dive in, explore, and discover how much simpler content management can be.
